title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Terms — Cancellation, Withdrawal and Closure of an Agreement
content:
**1. Cancellation.** The customer cancels an active Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement by confirming the cancellation; the drop takes effect on the premise's next scheduled meter read date, recorded as the drop effective date.

**2. Withdrawal of a cancellation.** A withdrawal is accepted only when the customer withdraws the cancellation before the scheduled gas drop takes effect on the drop effective date. Day one is the calendar day after the drop requested date, and the withdrawal period closes at the end of the calendar day before the drop effective date: the cut-off sits 0 calendar days ahead of the drop effective date, and the drop effective date itself is excluded. The drop effective date is read from the company's record of the agreement concerned.

**3. Closure after a drop.** When the utility completes the drop, the agreement closes with the close reason "cancelled by customer", or "move-out" when the drop reason was a move-out.

**4. Closure by the utility.** When the utility ends supply because another supplier enrolled the premise, the agreement closes with the close reason "switched to other supplier"; a utility move-out without a Beacon Ridge cancellation closes it with the close reason "move-out".

### Withdrawal boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Drop requested date | Drop effective date | Customer withdraws on | Withdrawal |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 March | 20 March | 3 March (day 1) | accepted |
| 2 March | 20 March | 19 March (the last day before the drop) | accepted |
| 2 March | 20 March | 20 March (the drop effective date) | not accepted |

### Close reasons

| How supply ended | Close reason |
|---|---|
| Utility completed a drop after the customer's cancellation | cancelled by customer |
| Utility completed a drop after a cancellation whose drop reason was a move-out | move-out |
| Utility ended supply because another supplier enrolled the premise | switched to other supplier |
| Utility move-out without a Beacon Ridge cancellation | move-out |
